dataset_provenance.skill_definition: TOEIC part minus one; coarse task category, not atomic skill
dataset_provenance.selection: SHA256(seed:learner_id) ascending; first eligible learners; earliest responses truncated
dataset_provenance.bundle_policy: One final answer per submitted bundle, selected by SHA256(seed:question_id); other answers excluded
dataset_provenance.ordering: Submission order; timestamp is ordinal; original shifted timestamp retained as source_timestamp_ms

behavior.revision_count: Changed choices for selected question before bundle submission; identical repeats excluded
behavior.duration_ms: Bundle enter-to-submit wall time; includes inactivity; not per-question active time

limitations: English/TOEIC data; no DeFi learning-effect evidence
Pilot selects learners with >= minimum submissions
One question per bundle discards data
Seven task categories simplify the original multi-tag skill structure
No hint or inspection features are inferred or fabricated
Independent learner cohort from the same EdNet platform, not an independent dataset
Exploratory follow-up, one selected sample and fixed training budget
Different representation widths imply different parameter counts
Multi-tag mean-logit model is an explicit extension of single-tag DKT
Predictive performance is not evidence of learning benefit or novelty
